name: Emajie
about: Emajie is a perfume house based in Ampang, Selangor, that makes extraits de parfum, most of them inspired by well-known designer and niche fragrances. It focuses on climate adaptation: it says its perfumes are engineered for Malaysian weather with its EMAJIEAir™ technology, and describes them as lightweight, long-lasting and comfortable for daily wear in hot, humid weather, indoors or outdoors.
